entries.obligation: Setup/state at most B^(9/4+o(1)), one fresh masked query at most B^(5/4+o(1)), and complete lambda,mu<=0.45.
The oracle must output k-dependent exact relations below the birthday bound and include factor logs plus blind descent; a universal identity or aggregate statistic is insufficient.
An exception must reduce the complete relation and descent cost, not only a solver proxy or total-degree Bezout convention.
Charge support generation, relation density, structured solve, factor-log completion, blind descent, memory, and verification.
Umbrella problem: no known checked classical prime-field index-calculus route beats rho after all stages are charged.
